name: Parallel Multiresolution Volume Rendering with Error-Guided Load Balancing
definition: A parallel algorithm for visualizing large 3D data sets that uses a wavelet tree for multiresolution representation and distributes data along a hierarchical space-filling curve guided by an error metric to balance workload and minimize communication.
summary: It is a parallel algorithm for interactive multiresolution volume rendering that uses wavelet trees and error-guided bucketization to balance workload without inter-processor data redistribution.
